power.title: NASA POWER daily point (MERRA-2 cell), AG community

imerg.title: NASA GPM IMERG daily precipitation V07 (Final run; Late run after the last Final day), 0.1 deg

grace.title: NASA GRACE/GRACE-FO data-assimilation drought indicators (GRACEDADM_CLSM025GL_7D v3.0), 0.25 deg weekly

eto.title: Hargreaves ETo (FAO-56 eq. 52) on POWER Tmax/Tmin, backend/regional

cover_class_ndvi.title: Rule-based class from Sentinel-2/Landsat NDVI/NDWI (backend/field); NDVI shown only on observation days, not interpolated

notes: imerg_precip_mm = NASA GPM IMERG daily rain at the field's 0.1 deg cell (imerg_run 'final' or 'late'); smap_sm_pct = SMAP L4 root-zone soil-moisture percentile (product sm_rootzone_pctl, daily mean of 3-hourly); smap_rootzone_m3m3 its volumetric value; smap_l3_sm_m3m3 = SMAP L3 surface retrieval, recommended quality only; grace_gw_pct = GRACE-DA groundwater percentile of the week containing the day. Null = not available that day.

Rows after 2025-12-31 use NASA POWER near-real-time values (power_run 'nrt', data/cache/<id>/power_nrt.parquet) with the same Hargreaves ETo and heat rules; NOAA station columns are null there (station cache ends earlier).
cover_class after the Sentinel-2/Landsat calendar ends comes from the HLS calendar (cover_source 'hls').
cover_class is 'unknown' before 2016 (no satellite classification) and across gaps > 30 days
ncei_* = mean over the selected NCEI stations, null where no station reported; precip/temps are not the same quantity as POWER (50 km reanalysis vs points)
POWER Tmax runs warm vs NCEI stations in summer (see /validation); severe_heat_40c / heatwave_day inherit that bias
